preregistration.written_after_fix_note: Written after implementing the review's three fixes below and before re-running the local (non-macOS) parts of the acceptance check; the macOS job itself still cannot be executed from this Linux worktree, so its blocker fix is verified by static re-inspection of the exact commands, not by an actual run.
preregistration.expectation: (1) Blocker fix: the macOS job's uv install, venv creation and pip install steps no longer activate the venv or call `python3 -m uv`; instead uv is a standalone downloaded binary invoked directly ($UV), and `uv pip install --python <venv>/bin/python3 --require-hashes ...` targets the venv's interpreter without needing it active or needing uv importable inside it. (2) Reproducibility fix: both the committed lock generation and the CI job's diff-check recompile now pass `--exclude-newer 2026-09-23T00:00:00Z`, so a transitive dependency publishing a new release after that cutoff cannot change the resolved set and fail the diff on an unrelated PR; re-running the exact same compile command with this flag must still produce a lock file byte-identical to the committed one (no version changes at this cutoff). (3) Unverified-download fix: uv is now downloaded from the same GitHub Releases host as validate.yml's Linux job, verified against a SHA-256 fetched independently from GitHub's own published checksum file for the aarch64-apple-darwin archive, using shasum -a 256 --check (the macOS-native equivalent of validate.yml's sha256sum --check).
preregistration.criteria: actionlint and zizmor --offline stay clean on the edited workflow; a local (Linux) `uv pip compile ... --exclude-newer 2026-09-23T00:00:00Z --no-header` re-run of tools/mlx-smoke/requirements.in is byte-identical to the committed tools/mlx-smoke/requirements.lock.txt, run twice to confirm determinism; the downloaded uv-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz's SHA-256 matches the value now embedded in the workflow, fetched independently from https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.17/uv-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz.sha256.
